name: easap-launch-agent
description: Prepare, execute, verify, and report an EASAP product launch with durable publication receipts.

interface.shortDescription: Execute the launch and track publication receipts.
interface.longDescription: Prepare channel-specific launch content, check product health and account readiness, execute approved scheduled posts, handle browser channels, verify publications, and report observed results.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run the EASAP launch agent. Prepare the campaign, check configured accounts, execute already-authorized work, and report publication receipts and blockers.
